what_this_round_added_to_its_own_procedu.statement: A mandated lane arm's POOL RANK is configuration and moves between rounds; a stale rank fails closed with 'the required arm is not in this lane's pool'. Read the pool file for the arm's actual rank and keep --require-arm with --force-rank so the receipt binds required == served.

The pre-tool guard's authorization is a per-session 3600 s token minted from an owner message (intent verb + target), or an ACTIVE registered route cited in the same call. When it denies, the agent cites a registered route or asks the user; it never mints the token itself. Diagnose from the token file's minted/expires fields to tell 'lapsed' from 'never minted'.

Driving a Chromium surface: one trusted foreground click per native file picker, backslash paths, poll the dialog's tree, raw EnumWindows for dialogs the toolkit misses, page body not exposed as named nodes, and accept the earlier round's success signature as the only oracle.

Publish then re-derive: a fresh clone readback at blob level (git ls-tree blob ids compared per file) verifies a packet even when the repository cannot be fully checked out on Windows (a deep path under .hgk/rounds exceeds MAX_PATH; reviewers need core.longpaths=true).
